source.revision: main da62d04 plus the release pull request for build maverick-public-dev-20261120.2 (build-sound-uki.sh, release notes, rights review, changelog, manifest)
source.dirty_delta: The build ran from copies in the maintainer candidate folder (tools/) and from builder/public-image/rootfs-overlay/ with content identical to the files in main (pull requests 21 to 24).
source.note: The root is derived from the pinned Phase 1 root (sha256 22dde19c5a9e0b2a6e00f30cce7d0866d08159e1127871793553cd0478d1aacf) by builder/public-image/build-root.sh, built in four steps (r10 = the dev.3 root; r11 adds PKGS="pipewire-audio pipewire-pulse plasma-pa libgpiod" and the sound overlay; r12 adds pipewire-alsa and the shutdown drop-ins; r13 adds the fz-bootmnt-ro service), each a full system upgrade with PRUNE=1, the overlay files, a prebuilt ld.so.cache and size reduction.

inputs.uki_change: The first boot entry uses froodzos-maverick-dspM.efi: the base boot image (sha256 above) with its device tree replaced by a copy patched by fz-dtb-fixup.py --all-pas --sound-nodp --wsa-right-gpio13 (orphaned interconnect votes, USB PHY, DisplayPort dai-links of the sound card, right speaker amplifier reset on gpio13) and fz-board-touchpad.py (FocalTech touchpad at I2C 0x38, interrupt TLMM GPIO 19); only the .dtbauto section differs from the base image (builder/public-image/build-sound-uki.sh checks this). The second entry uses the unchanged dev.2 touchpad image.
inputs.menu: output/grub.cfg.public11 (sha256 4957b15127dfd27302b4eb4a3efbeab6187235084dbfb85cec56d56c50489012) generated from the dev.3 menu (grub.cfg.public10) by changing the version text and the first entry image; two boot entries and a firmware entry, no submenu, no chain-loading; kernel options include kestrel_graphics_unbounded=1, sysctl.kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0, cow_spacesize=2G; no fz_autorun, fz_persist or fz_dsp
inputs.root_package_origin: 782 pacman packages (all unmodified Arch Linux ARM except the one project-built kernel); plus two unmodified upstream release tarballs (Helium, Zen) listed in pkglist.tsv
other_removals: usr/lib/firmware/updates (vendor firmware extracted from a Windows installation)
pacman keyring private key and revocation certificate
project-local overlay repository and its signature
four Arch Linux logo files (usr/share/pixmaps/archlinux-logo*) and the LOGO reference
firmware for other Qualcomm chip families and older Wi-Fi generations
development headers, introspection and cmake files

test_receipts.name: native boot of the first-entry boot image and the r12 and r13 roots on the Lenovo 83N3
test_receipts.result: on 2026-11-20 the owner booted the first-entry boot image (identical sha256) with the r12 root and then with the r13 root (the released root, byte-identical, sha256 above) from a private test stick that also supplied this laptop's own audio firmware and a start-up script: left, right and both speakers play from the start of the boot without any helper service; shutdown about 10 s; with r13 the stick is left without the FAT dirty flag. The released image itself was not written to a stick and booted.
test_receipts.scope: owner test, one laptop; private menu (adds fz_autorun, fz_persist, fz_dsp, fz_tplg); the released image was not itself booted on the laptop

limitations: No sound out of the box: the audio DSP needs this machine's own firmware and a start-up step, neither of which the image contains; no sound card appears. The device tree, topology, UCM profile and PipeWire are in place.
Graphics are software-rendered (llvmpipe) on a firmware framebuffer; there is no GPU acceleration. USB-C display output and alternate modes are not claimed.
Touchpad: the kernel driver binds and the pad works in an owner test; gesture quality is unconfirmed. The second boot entry keeps the user-space polling driver.
Battery level, charge state and USB-C power data work in an owner test; power management beyond that is not claimed.
Wi-Fi does not recover after suspend and resume; suspend and resume are not claimed. A memory-bandwidth monitor driver (bwmon) fails to load its table.
RAR is extract-only (UnRAR licence). Wine, Waydroid and QEMU are not included.
Helium and Zen are unmodified third-party releases; their trademark and artwork terms were not reviewed separately and the Helium signing key is not otherwise certified.
Browser sandboxes need unprivileged user namespaces; the image sets kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0.
Boot loader and kernel images are unsigned; Secure Boot must be off. The downloads are signed (SHA256SUMS.asc).
The release image itself was only emulator-tested; the owner-tested roots (r12, r13 on a private stick with firmware add-ons) are the same file family.
Opt-in persistence (fz_persist=1) was tested on hardware only on the private stick; whoever holds the stick can read what is stored on the persistent partition.
No vendor firmware is included. Default live accounts are those of the development image (user live, password live).
Arch Linux ARM publishes no explicit redistribution statement; the maintainer acceptance of the three-year written source offer is recorded at release approval.
